verdicts.title: A dropped call resumes itself: save the record first, then a cancellable redial
verdicts.premise_notes: The lockout premise holds at FULL strength after r07 voice-interview-api/A: isInterviewSessionLive (interviews.ts:472 = 30 min, :482-493) is true only for status in_progress within 30 min of the later of updated_at and last_activity_at - and last_activity_at is stamped on every director exchange (director-step.ts:147), so the window starts at roughly the drop, not the connect. The ONLY caller of completeInterviewSession is complete/route.ts:280; the director route refuses non-live sessions but never changes status; there is no stale sweep; 39e918fcb changes what /complete stores, not who flips in_progress. The same token has no resume flag on /connect (body: provider, token, language, consent, recordingConsent), buildResumeContext reads earlier attempts whatever their status - it is the :161-163 ALREADY_LIVE gate alone that blocks. start() still clears saveFailed (:874) and nulls both refs (:925-926) before /connect (:943); persistence: PERSIST_ATTEMPTS 3 (~3 s total), mount-only stash replay (:169), online re-drive gated at :222; the 409 discardedTurns refusal :107-126; en.json :2446/:1829/:2538; connectLimit 6 per 10 min (:207-208). Two design gaps: (1) saveStateOf as specified maps every non-429 permanent 4xx (400/403/404, 409 revoked/INACTIVE without discardedTurns) to 'failed' because persistTranscript returns {saved:false, discardedTurns:0} for all of them - 'save_first' would then re-drive forever; 'refused' needs the hook to expose the HTTP class. (2) The ElevenLabs drop never reaches handleOaiDrop: onDisconnect (elevenlabs.ts:120-127) -> onClosed -> finalize(currentFinalStatus()) at :711 with no errConnectionLost - the plan effect must key on finalize's outcome. Note: on a directed call the ledger already holds the received turns server-side, so an unsaved /complete loses status and the unacknowledged tail only - 'save first' is about releasing the lock more than preserving data.
verdicts.floor_notes: M, effort 7, impact 8, risk 6, gate contract, 10 files, ~450-630 lines. Collides with voice/A inside VoiceInterview.tsx finalize() and start() - run after A.
